provenance.note: Identity directory for Kolar: 154 LGD-coded Gram Panchayats in 6 taluks. The Panchayat list, each Panchayat's covered villages and the taluk list come from the Local Government Directory as republished monthly on data.gov.in (api, bulk CSV export); the JJM village enumeration from the citizen corner (scrape); Census 2011 village rows from the Karnataka DCHB release (xlsx extract), joined by village code because that release prints each Panchayat's name without a code; centroids and areas from DataMeet's village polygons (ODbL) joined through its 2001-to-2011 crosswalk. Blocks are LGD sub-districts (taluks), each aligned to a JJM block by name or by the reviewed block alignment. JJM bindings are the name crosswalk's, each labelled proposed until a reviewer verifies it; Census bindings are the register's own coverage (match class lgd-coverage), authoritative but partial because the export lists 286 covering villages for 154 Panchayats in a district of 1825 villages. Raw responses are content-addressed under .cache/atlas/; the reviewed plan, resolution and block alignment live under pipeline-inputs/atlas/.

conventions.key: lgdCode is the LGD local-body code of the Gram Panchayat; blockCode is the LGD sub-district (taluk) code
conventions.bindings: jjm bindings carry matchClass (how the pairing was made) and status (proposed | verified); a census binding with matchClass lgd-coverage is the LGD register's own statement of which villages the Panchayat covers, joined to Census 2011 rows by village code, and is marked proposed only because no person has re-checked it
conventions.composition: reviewed = a plan target a person checked; crosswalk = the LGD-covered villages, authoritative but possibly incomplete; unbound = the register lists no village with a Census row
conventions.uncoveredVillages: district villages the Local Bodies register lists under no Panchayat, kept so the enumeration stays complete
conventions.centroid: [longitude, latitude] of the DataMeet MultiPolygon's bounding-box centre
conventions.datameet: ODbL 1.0: attribution required, share-alike on the derived polygons, which are served under boundaries/<block>.geojson

boundary.withheldNote: The LGD export lists 286 of the district's 1,825 villages under its 154 Panchayats, one or two each, so the union of a Panchayat's listed villages is not its extent: no outline or area is drawn until the full village-to-Panchayat mapping is on file.
